verdict.rationale: Nix is a CLI-first tool with an official, documented command reference (`nix build`, `nix run`, `nix develop`) and a scriptable curl-based installer, so it can run headlessly. Community reports confirm non-interactive automation via `nix-shell --run "<cmd>"` and production use across CI with shared remote builders and binary caches. Missing for 10: first-party CI/headless guidance (e.g. CI integration docs, non-interactive flags, machine-readable output) and documented unattended-install options.
